headline: 32 students hospitalised after drinking school tubewell water in Tangail
summary: Students of Mahmudnagar High School fell ill after consuming water from a school tubewell in Nagarpur Upazila.
details: At least 32 students have been hospitalised after drinking water from a tubewell at a school in Tangail’s Nagarpur Upazila.
The incident occurred at Mahmudnagar High School, sparking panic among other pupils and staff.
The illness was reported around 10:30 am on Tuesday, according to Nagarpur Police chief Md Jahurul Islam.
The affected students are currently receiving treatment at the Nagarpur Upazila Health Complex and Tangail Medical College Hospital.
